scope: Basic invariants computed for each deformed atlas part and recomputed during saved-edit regeneration
export_field: edit_checks keyed by atlas part ID
checks: Finite edited geometry and centerline values
Preserved endpoint node IDs, positions and radii
Newly degenerate triangles separated from inherited source defects
policy: Non-default deformations with FAIL basic invariants are rejected before publication, including regeneration from saved edits. This is not a complete geometry acceptance gate. Restoring the exact original remains available and inherited source defects are reported separately.
command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_atlas_edit_checks.py tests/test_atlas_modification.py tests/test_atlas_edit_session.py tests/test_atlas_workspace.py -q
real_atlas_inspection_this_change: PASS for FJ1692 combined edit basic invariants; see atlas-mca-edit-invariants.json
limitations: Passing basic invariants does not mean a closed, collision-free, smooth or anatomically valid vessel. Existing degenerate triangles can remain even when no new degenerate triangles are introduced.
